project: German AI Text Detection GBERT-large Suite

organic_gbert_large.name: Organic GBERT-large (News & Casual)
organic_gbert_large.description: Trained exclusively on organic, non-templated News (GNAD) and Casual (GermEval) German texts. Generalizes to stylistic indicators (indirect speech subjunctive vs. LLM direct statements) rather than exploiting template shortcuts.

v5_best_model_clean.name: v5 GBERT-large (Clean / Robust)
v5_best_model_clean.description: Our most advanced model. Trained on length-balanced, template-stripped data to eliminate layout and phrasing shortcuts. Generalizes best to unseen out-of-distribution texts.
v5_best_model_clean.dataset: 193,474 train rows (from 435,178-row source pool, length-stratified + template-stripped)
v5_best_model_clean.notes: Resolves all 3 shortcuts: whitespace leakage, template-collapse, length-bias. Best OOD generalizer.

v5_best_model.name: v5 GBERT-large (Baseline)
v5_best_model.description: Baseline model for the v5 dataset, trained with repeating template statements.
v5_best_model.dataset: 193,474 train rows (435,178-row source pool, whitespace-cleaned, templates NOT removed)
v5_best_model.notes: Achieves perfect in-distribution F1 by memorising 568 template phrases. OOD drops to 35.44%.

best_model.name: v1 GBERT-large (Best Model)
best_model.description: The original baseline GBERT-large trained on the ~57k dataset version.
best_model.dataset: 45,916 train rows (57,396 total v1 balanced dataset — 28,698 human / 28,698 AI)
best_model.notes: Original best-checkpoint model. Early stopping at epoch 3. ROC-AUC = 1.0000. Solid OOD baseline.

full_model.name: v1 GBERT-large (Full Model)
full_model.description: GBERT-large trained on the full 57k dataset version without early stopping.
full_model.dataset: 45,916 train rows (57,396 total v1 balanced — full 3 epochs, no early stopping)
full_model.notes: Full-epoch run of v1. Practically identical to best_model (F1 delta < 0.01%). ROC-AUC = 1.0000.

full_model_500k.name: 500k GBERT-large (Massive Dataset)
full_model_500k.description: Model trained on the massive 500k corpus. Experienced model during training, tending to predict a single class.
full_model_500k.dataset: 782,587 train rows (978,234 total corpus — train 782,587 · val 97,823 · test 97,824)
full_model_500k.notes: Ran 3 full epochs — ALL collapsed. Val F1 stuck at 33.82% every epoch; val loss rose 1.08→1.53→1.89. ROC-AUC 0.6829. Best checkpoint: checkpoint-48912 (epoch 1). Class imbalance + label noise + LR decay to 0.0 caused total divergence.

legal_model.name: Legal GBERT-large (Law Focus)
legal_model.description: Fine-tuned model with special emphasis on legal text and legislative sentence style.
legal_model.dataset: Domain-focused legal corpus (Bundestag + Bundesrat + German statutory law texts)
legal_model.notes: Specialised on German legislative style. Strong on legal docs, weaker on general German (OOD 58.30%).

model_100k.name: 100k GBERT-large (Intermediate)
model_100k.description: Trained on the intermediate 100k corpus split.
model_100k.dataset: 49,218 train rows (70,294 total — the '100k' label refers to source pool, actual splits are 70k)
model_100k.splits: train 49,218 · val 10,538 · test 10,538 = 70,294 total (perfectly balanced 24,609 / 24,609 per class in train)
model_100k.notes: Intermediate scale between v1 (57k) and v5 (262k). Solid F1 with modest OOD generalisation (61.20%).
